title.full: What IP riders are and what to consider

summary.text: IP riders cover part of your plan's deductible and co-insurance. Consider co-payment, extra benefits, and if you can afford long-term costs.

details.heading: What riders do
details.body: IP riders are optional products designed to cover part of the deductible and co-insurance of your Integrated Shield Plan (IP). quotes.text: If you are covered by CareShield Life/ElderShield, you will be eligible to claim in the event of severe disability. This means that you must be unable to perform at least three out of the six Activities of Daily Living (ADLs).

The six ADLs are: • Washing – the ability to wash in the bath or shower (including getting into and out of the bath or shower) or do a sponge/bed bath. • Dressing – the ability to put on, take off, secure and unfasten all garments and, as appropriate, any braces, artificial limbs or other surgical or medical appliances. • Feeding – the ability to feed oneself food after it has been prepared and made available. • Toileting – the ability to use the toilet or manage bowel and bladder function through the use of protective undergarments such as diapers or surgical appliances if appropriate. • Mobility – the ability to move indoors from room to room on level surfaces. • Transferring – the ability to move from a bed to an upright chair or wheelchair, and vice versa.

title.full: Who can opt out of CareShield Life

summary.text: It depends on your age, citizenship or residency, and how you joined CareShield Life.

details.heading: Born in 1980 or later
details.body: If you are a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident born in 1980 or later, you cannot opt out. CareShield Life is mandatory for you.

details.heading: Born 1970 to 1979
details.body: If you were automatically enrolled in 2021, you could opt out by 31 December 2023. You cannot opt out after that date.

details.heading: You chose to join
details.body: If you chose to join CareShield Life, you can opt out during the 60-day free-look period from your cover commencement date. You cannot opt out after that period.

details.heading: New citizens or permanent residents
details.body: If you became a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident from 1 October 2020 onwards, were born in 1979 or earlier, and have not developed severe disability, CareShield Life is mandatory.
